subject_definitions
<Subject 1> is the young woman in <Picture 1>: a platinum-blonde bob with straight blunt bangs topped by a large brown fabric bow headband, big brown eyes with soft pink blush and glossy pink lips, wearing a white off-shoulder loose long-sleeve top with a bold red-and-black comic graphic print, shoulders and collarbones exposed.
<Subject 2> is the cave-like waterfront cafe interior in <Picture 2>: a sculpted cream plaster cave ceiling and undulating columns with warm recessed downlights, long wooden tables set with dusty-pink placemats and napkin holders, a built-in bench along the left wall lined with ethnic striped patterned cushions and round seat pads, a bright rectangular opening revealing a waterfront terrace with water and sky, a staff figure in black with a black wide-brim hat in the mid-ground, a red fire box mounted on a column, a small green exit sign on the right column, and a light stone floor.

summary
[reference generation] The target video is a 15-second six-shot sorrowful single-subject vibe short of <Subject 1> in the cave-like waterfront cafe <Subject 2> - a slow over-the-shoulder turn, hugging a striped cushion, tracing its pattern with a small sigh, rising and walking toward the bright water-view opening to lean against a column, a failed reassuring smile that fades into sadness, and a final faint wistful smile with one slow blink - backlit by the bright opening, with a muted cool grey-blue grade against warm cream cave highlights, handheld filmic texture, and no dialogue.

retention_analysis
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4], [Shot 5], [Shot 6]): fully_preserved - her facial identity, platinum-blonde bob with blunt bangs, brown bow headband, blush and glossy lips, and white off-shoulder graphic top are retained.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4], [Shot 5], [Shot 6]): fully_preserved - the cave ceiling and columns, downlights, tables with pink placemats, cushion bench (minus the one hugged cushion), bright water-view opening, staff figure, red fire box, and green exit sign keep their exact layout and positions unchanged.

detailed_description
The target video uses a handheld filmic vlog style with soft halation, gentle film grain, shallow depth of field, and a muted cool grey-blue shadow palette warmed by the cream cave walls, with slow sorrowful pacing and breath-like handheld sway. Global rules: no dialogue; <Subject 1> never speaks - lips may part softly but never articulate, and she never eats or drinks; were she ever to speak, she would first put down any held object, visibly swallow, and articulate crisply with an empty mouth - not applicable here. Prop ledger: exactly one ethnic striped cushion is drawn from the bench into her arms in [Shot 2]; once hugged, it must not simultaneously remain on the bench, and it stays hugged through [Shot 3]-[Shot 6]; all tables, placemats, napkin holders, remaining cushions, and round seat pads stay fixed in place. Worn accessory: the brown bow headband stays fixed on her head the entire time - never slipping, never in hand, never vanishing. <Subject 1> holds no object other than the cushion; her walking path in [Shot 4] crosses the open stone floor without touching anything else. The staff figure and the terrace guests beyond the opening remain tiny, blurred, nearly still; the red fire box and green exit sign stay fixed and unchanged.
[Shot 1] The video opens dreamy and slightly defocused with gentle halation, then racks into sharp focus within the first second. A medium shot from a three-quarter back angle shows <Subject 1> sitting on the built-in bench of <Subject 2>, her back mostly to the camera, gazing at the bright water-view opening; the pale backlight rims her blonde bob against the cream cave wall. Noticing the camera, she slowly turns her head over her right shoulder, lashes downcast first, then lifting her eyes to the lens with a quiet hollow sadness, lips softly parted without a sound. End state: <Subject 1> at a three-quarter over-the-shoulder angle, eyes resting on the lens, hands at rest on the bench.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.500, inheriting the previous end state with <Subject 1> turned toward the camera, the shot cuts to a frontal medium shot. (a) She reaches to the side and draws one ethnic striped cushion from the bench, (b) hugs it to her chest with both arms, (c) rests her chin on its top edge; the cushion no longer remains on the bench. Her gaze drifts past the tables toward the bright opening, watching the water light shimmer, and she gives one slow blink. End state: <Subject 1> hugging the cushion, chin on the cushion, eyes toward the opening.
[Shot 3] At 00:05.000, inheriting the previous end state with the cushion hugged and chin resting on it, the shot tightens to a medium close. Her index finger slowly traces the striped pattern of the cushion; then she lifts her gaze to the warm downlights embedded in the cave ceiling, shoulders rising and falling with one small sighing breath, and she tightens her arms around the cushion as if holding onto something, lashes lowering again. End state: <Subject 1> hugging the cushion closely, eyes downcast, finger resting on the cushion.
[Shot 4] At 00:07.500, inheriting the previous end state with the cushion hugged and eyes downcast, the shot cuts to a handheld follow shot: the camera backs up as <Subject 1> slowly rises from the bench and walks along the open stone floor toward the bright opening, still hugging the cushion, shoulders slightly hunched. She stops beside an undulating cream column and leans her shoulder lightly against it, her gaze lifting toward the water and the tiny terrace figures beyond. End state: <Subject 1> leaning against the column, hugging the cushion, eyes toward the water.
[Shot 5] At 00:10.000, inheriting the previous end state leaning against the column with the cushion hugged, a medium close shot from the side shows <Subject 1> sensing the lens and turning her face toward it; she tucks a loose strand of blonde hair behind her ear and tries a small reassuring smile for the camera - but the smile falters and fades into sadness, her lips pressing together softly, eyes glistening under the soft halation. End state: <Subject 1> with a subdued sad expression, gaze resting just off the lens, hair tucked behind her ear.
[Shot 6] At 00:12.500, inheriting the previous end state with the faded smile and off-lens gaze, the shot cuts to a quiet close-up; the bright opening glows softly out of focus behind her, rim-lighting her hair, the bow headband perfectly fixed, the hugged cushion's edge visible at the frame bottom. She slowly brings her eyes back to the lens; a faint wistful almost-smile forms; one slow blink and a small head tilt toward the cushion; she holds this gentle sorrow steady until the final frame. End state: still close-up, faint wistful smile, eyes resting on the lens.

overall_soundscape
Hushed cave-cafe ambience throughout: a low muffled cafe murmur, distant water lapping and a faint seaside breeze drifting in from the opening, the soft fabric rustle of the cushion being drawn and hugged in [Shot 2], one very soft sighing breath in [Shot 3], slow soft footsteps on the stone floor and one distant gull cry in [Shot 4], a faint ceramic cup clink from the mid-ground, and near-silent room tone under the final close-up.

non_diegetic_music
A sorrowful cue of sparse felt-piano notes over an airy string pad and a low sustained cello drone; the cello swells gently as she walks toward the light in [Shot 4], thins out under the failed smile in [Shot 5], and fades to a single soft piano note with room tone under the final close-up, keeping an intimate, aching mood.
